Use current source hashes for edits. Final context is evaluated against the pinned base revision: retrieve relevant base evidence before selecting context containing edited or inserted lines. Finish with finish_issue_attempt, then report the relevant delivered source context used. Report inability honestly; do not claim unverified repairs.

Each observation source_ref indexes sources; merge that source record with the observation. derived_retrieval_handle:true means retrieval_handle is observed-read: followed by read_id. ## Summary

closes #1971

## Details

Added a dot option to view the current branch's readme.md file

`gh repo view .`


* takes the remote branch of the current user if exist
* otherwise takes the readme file in my local

Also added the description in the view if the displayed readme file is taken from remote or local

:tada: This is my first PR to this project! :raised_hands:

`gh` is GitHub on the command line. It brings pull requests, issues, and other GitHub concepts to the terminal next to where you are already working with `git` and your code.

![screenshot of gh pr status](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/98482/84171218-327e7a80-aa40-11ea-8cd1-5177fc2d0e72.png)

## Availability

GitHub CLI is available for repositories hosted on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server 2.20+, and to install on macOS, Windows, and Linux. 


## Documentation

Read the [official docs][] for usage and more information.



## We want your feedback

We'd love to hear your feedback about `gh`. If you spot bugs or have features that you'd really like to see in `gh`, please check out the [contributing page][].

## Comparison with hub

For many years, [hub][] was the unofficial GitHub CLI tool. `gh` is a new project that helps us explore
what an official GitHub CLI tool can look like with a fundamentally different design. While both
tools bring GitHub to the terminal, `hub` behaves as a proxy to `git`, and `gh` is a standalone
tool. Check out our [more detailed explanation][gh-vs-hub] to learn more.

Hi! Thanks for your interest in contributing to the GitHub CLI!

We accept pull requests for bug fixes and features where we've discussed the approach in an issue and given the go-ahead for a community member to work on it. We'd also love to hear about ideas for new features as issues.

Please do:

* check existing issues to verify that the [bug][bug issues] or [feature request][feature request issues] has not already been submitted
* open an issue if things aren't working as expected
* open an issue to propose a significant change
* open a pull request to fix a bug
* open a pull request to fix documentation about a command
* open a pull request if a member of the GitHub CLI team has given the ok after discussion in an issue

Please avoid:

* adding installation instructions specifically for your OS/package manager

## Building the project

Prerequisites:
- Go 1.13+ for building the binary
- Go 1.15+ for running the test suite

Build with: `make` or `go build -o bin/gh ./cmd/gh`

Run the new binary as: `./bin/gh`

Run tests with: `make test` or `go test ./...`

function.description: Page tracked source paths containing query. Use next_offset until null.
function.name: list_files

function.description: Read exact whole source lines from base or current revision. source_sha256 identifies the full file; use current hash for edits.
function.name: read_file

function.description: Search source. Default literal mode returns literal matches. Set mode ranked, revision base, path_prefix empty, offset 0 and limit 1..5 to retrieve ranked exact source windows directly.
function.name: search

function.description: Apply an atomic validated batch of unique exact replacements to current tracked files; every expected full-file hash must match.
function.name: apply_edits

function.description: Get the current source patch against the pinned base commit.
function.name: get_patch

function.description: Find ranked path and line-range hints in the pinned base repository, including unread files. Hints are not source observations. Use read_file with revision base to acquire evidence; index exclusions and omitted hints are explicit.
function.name: rank_sources

function.description: Read exact original source bytes from an immutable tool-output archive, even after working-tree edits. Use the archive digest and observation index in deferred.archive_recovery; this is not a fresh repository read.
function.name: recover_archived_read

function.description: Finish the issue-resolution attempt and report the delivered source context used. This does not assert patch correctness.
function.name: finish_issue_attempt

scope: Scripted representative tool output; not model generation or confirmed source delivery. Zero retained windows do not qualify useful ranked-source exposure.
